satisfies.description: the relation on a link: doing this served that purpose

goal_new.title: Set a goal
goal_new.description: Set a standing purpose that work serves rather than finishes: it has no status and is never done. satisfied_by links the work that already serves it. Returns applied bundles.

body.description: What it means and how to tell it is served, as Markdown.

scope.description: Project id or name it holds for; omit for everywhere.

satisfied_by.description: Ids of the work that served this goal: each becomes a satisfies link from it to the goal.

goal_list.title: List goals
goal_list.description: Return whole goals matching query, always narrowed by .goal; without one, every goal. Filters use .component.property=value; bare words search text. The work serving a goal is .satisfies.to=<goal>.

goal_update.title: Update a goal
goal_update.description: Patch a goal's words or scope, and link work that serves it. Omitted fields stay; null clears. Returns applied bundles.
